title: A hospital bill
description: A bill for an emergency room visit. It has some mistakes for the app to find.
paper_text:
RIVERSIDE GENERAL HOSPITAL
PATIENT STATEMENT

Statement date: 10/15/2026          Account #: 7730-11842
Patient: Maria Lopez                Guarantor: Maria Lopez
Insurance: BlueRiver Health Plan, Member ID BRH-449120

DATE OF SERVICE  DESCRIPTION                                   AMOUNT
09/22/2026       ED visit, level 4 (CPT 99284)                $1,250.00
09/22/2026       CT abdomen/pelvis w/ contrast (CPT 74177)    $2,400.00
09/22/2026       Comprehensive metabolic panel (CPT 80053)      $185.00
09/22/2026       Comprehensive metabolic panel (CPT 80053)      $185.00
09/22/2026       IV infusion, initial hour (CPT 96365)          $320.00

                 TOTAL CHARGES                                $4,430.00
10/05/2026       Insurance payment - BlueRiver Health Plan   -$3,100.00
10/05/2026       Contractual adjustment                        -$620.00
10/01/2026       Patient payment - thank you                    -$50.00

                 AMOUNT DUE                                     $660.00
                 PAYMENT DUE BY                              11/14/2026

Questions about your bill? Call Patient Financial Services at (555) 014-2290, Monday-Friday, 8 AM-5 PM.
Financial assistance may be available. Ask for an application or visit the Patient Financial Services office, 1st floor.
Accounts not paid by the due date may be sent to collections.

simple.summary: This is a bill from Riverside General Hospital for your emergency room visit on September 22, 2026. It says you owe $660.00 by November 14, 2026.

concerns.issue: The bill says that if you don't pay by November 14, 2026, it may be sent to collections.
concerns.why_it_matters: Collections can make a bill harder to fix later.
concerns.what_to_do: If you think something on the bill is wrong, call Patient Financial Services at (555) 014-2290 before November 14, 2026.

key_points: This bill is for your emergency room visit on September 22, 2026.
Your insurance, BlueRiver Health Plan, paid $3,100.00.
The hospital took $620.00 off because of its deal with your insurance.
You already paid $50.00 on October 1, 2026. Thank you.
You may be able to get help paying. This is called financial assistance.

todos.task: Pay the bill, or call about it, before the due date.
Call Patient Financial Services at (555) 014-2290 with questions. They are open Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM.
If you need help paying, ask for a financial assistance application. You can call or visit the office on the 1st floor.

questions_for_doctor: Did I really get the blood test 2 times?

questions.question: How much do I really owe?
questions.answer: The bill says you owe $660.00. But the charges listed add up to $4,340.00, not the $4,430.00 the bill shows. Using the lines on the bill, you would owe $570.00. A blood test is also listed 2 times. Call Patient Financial Services at (555) 014-2290 and ask them to check before you pay.

questions.question: How can I get help paying this bill?
questions.answer: The bill says financial assistance may be available. You can ask for an application by calling Patient Financial Services at (555) 014-2290, Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. You can also visit their office on the 1st floor.

questions.question: What happens if I don't pay by the due date?
questions.answer: The bill says accounts not paid by November 14, 2026 may be sent to collections. If you think the bill is wrong, call (555) 014-2290 before that date.
